verdict.rationale: The evidence shows controls over how deleted source records are handled in the destination: delete capture plus Soft Delete, Live and History sync modes. It also shows data-minimization tools (column-level data blocking, column hashing and row filtering) that keep data from being synced. However, nothing in the pack documents retention periods or deletion of data Fivetran itself processes or stores. missing for 10: configurable retention windows, documented deletion of Fivetran-held/processed data, data-subject deletion workflow, privacy/retention policy docs, independent corroboration.
